decisions.reason: The modular mobile waste processing concept builds directly on the firm's core shredding and screening know-how and already has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, so the firm can interpret its results and keep developing it.
A mobile slow-speed shredder is the firm's core competence, has a page of its own, and benefits fully from existing engineering, service and telematics knowledge.
As the flagship modular plant line with several models, it combines existing machine know-how with the firm's stated strategic direction, and a growing firm will keep refining it rather than drop it.

Trommel screens are a closely related established technology that fits the modular system and draws on existing production and service capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and dropping it is unlikely.
